proof_of_address.name: Electricity Bill (Last 3 Months in Applicant's Name)
Photo Passbook of Scheduled Public/Private Sector Bank Account
Spouse's Passport Copy (First & Last Page with matching address)

proof_of_dob.name: Birth Certificate issued by Municipal Authority / Registrar of Births
Transfer / School Leaving / Matriculation (10th) Certificate with DOB
PAN Card issued by Income Tax Department
Aadhaar Card / e-Aadhaar with Full Verified Date of Birth
Driving License issued by RTO/Transport Department

non_ecr_proof.name: Matriculation (10th Standard) or Higher Educational Degree / Marksheet
Income Tax Assessment Order / ITR-V (Proof of Tax Paid for Last 1 Year)
non_ecr_proof.description: All individual tax payers with verified ITR acknowledgment

non_ecr_proof.name: Proof of Age 50 Years or Above
non_ecr_proof.description: Any citizen who has completed 50 years of age

non_ecr_proof.name: Minor Children Under 18 Years of Age
non_ecr_proof.description: All minor children are granted Non-ECR status

non_ecr_proof.name: Government Servant / PSU Employee Identity Card & NOC
non_ecr_proof.description: Central/State government employees and their dependent family members

ANNEXURE_D.name: Annexure D (Minor Passport Declaration)
ANNEXURE_D.trigger: Minor applying for fresh passport with both parents' consent

ANNEXURE_E.name: Annexure E (Standard Self-Declaration for Tatkaal / Citizenship)
ANNEXURE_E.trigger: Standard citizenship & no criminal record declaration for Tatkaal applicants

ANNEXURE_F.name: Annexure F (Lost / Damaged Passport Affidavit)
ANNEXURE_F.trigger: Reissue request where previous passport is lost, damaged, or mutilated

ANNEXURE_J.name: Annexure J (Joint Declaration for Minor with One Parent Abroad)
ANNEXURE_J.trigger: Minor application where one parent is residing abroad
